title: onboard-calypso-pro-13b-v1.1-performance-metadata-and-changelog-automation
author: Ava Chen
release_notes:
- Onboarded Calypso Pro 13B v1.1 with verified performance profiles and metadata.
- Automated changelog entries generated for model catalog and release notes.
- Updated docs and added a perf-smoke test to CI.
- No breaking API changes; recommended default profile is `balanced-1` for latency-sensitive workloads.
description:
Onboard Calypso Pro 13B v1.1 to the model registry and wire up automated changelog/release-note generation. Motivation: Calypso Pro v1.1 contains quantization-friendly weights and improved KV cache layout that reduce tail latency for long-sequence/chat workloads. This PR adds metadata, calibrated performance profiles, CI perf-smoke coverage, and an automation hook that appends a human-readable entry to the models changelog when new model versions land.

Changes in this PR: - models/calypso-pro/metadata.yaml: new version entry (v1.1) with model alias, architecture, tokenizer, and recommended quantization profiles. - perf/calypso-pro-13b/v1.1/profiles.json: measured throughput/latency profiles across representative sequence lengths (32/128/512) on our N4/GPU fleet; includes cost-estimates and recommended production profiles (balanced-1, latency-2). - scripts/automation/generate_changelog.py: automation that composes the changelog entry from model metadata and perf summary; runs as a post-merge GitHub Action. - docs/models/calypso-pro.md: user-facing notes on v1.1 improvements and migration guidance. - ci/model-registry.yml: adds perf-smoke job for calypso-pro-13b to catch regressions in serving runtime and quantization path. - tests/perf/calypso_pro_smoke.py: lightweight integrated perf test used by CI and perf lab.

Testing and validation: - Perf profiles validated against internal perf harness (benchmarker) using a 1k-sample prompt corpus representative of customer workloads. - Smoke tests run in CI across UVM (cpu fallback) and GPU runners; flaky perf-smoke test was rerun once and passed. - Automation tested in a staging run (dry-run) to confirm changelog formatting and metadata extraction.

Rollout plan: - Merge to main with `squash` and tag model registry release. - Monitor perf and regressions via console dashboards and the per-model SLO alerts for 72 hours. - If regressions detected, rollback to v1.0 profile via model pinning in the registry.

Checklist: [x] metadata file added and schema-validated [x] perf profiles uploaded and reviewed [x] docs updated [x] CI perf-smoke added [x] changelog automation implemented and smoke-tested

Related: ENG-4821, PM-178, SUP-9123.

notes_for_release: Calypso Pro 13B v1.1: improved KV-cache layout and quantization support reduces median token latency by ~12% at sequence=512 for balanced profile. Recommend testing balanced-1 and latency-2 profiles in staging before defaulting for latency-sensitive routes.
migration_guide:
- If you pin to model version, update references to `calypso-pro:v1.1`.
- For latency-sensitive workloads, try `latency-2` profile; for cost-sensitive batch workloads, `balanced-1` yields a good trade-off.
- No tokenizer changes required.
- Reach out to inference-eng@redwood.com for rollout assistance.
